messages:
maria: Heads up — starting canary deploy in 15m for release/rls-2026-03. We'll roll the feature flag in three cohorts (10% -> 50% -> 100%).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by maria at 2026-03-20T10:30Z. Canary on infra-canary-3. Notifying eng-releases. :rocket:

jamal: quick Q — what's the explicit rollback triggers? want to pin them in the thread.

olivia: Rollback rules we agreed: 1) 5xx rate increase > 0.5% absolute vs baseline for 5m, 2) p95 latency regresses > 200ms, 3) user-facing error alerts from Support x2 in 10m. If any hit, roll back and open incident.

kevin: I'll pin the routing model and the runtime bundle before the flag ramp. Command: `redwoodctl release pin rls-2026-03 --bundle runtime-3.4.1 --model model-v2.1.3`

maria: thx kevin. Also we'll enable prefix caching on the canary to reduce noise.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment complete on infra-canary-3. Feature flag "safetywave_toggle" currently OFF. Ready to enable cohort 1 (10%).

maria: enabling cohort 1 now. Command: `redwood-ctl ff set safetywave_toggle true --cohort=1 --note="canary 10%"`

deploy-bot: safetywave_toggle set to true for cohort 1 (10%). Observability hooks active.

jamal: monitoring p50/p95, 5xx, token costs. also check reranker latency (it flares).

olivia: initial 10m looks clean. p95 +15ms, 5xx unchanged. can we move to 50% in 10m unless anyone objects?

sre-oncall: I'll watch infra errors and the autoscaler. If we see node OOMs or sustained queue growth, I'll call rollback.

maria: go for 50% in 10. setting reminder. :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: Rolling to cohort 2 (50%) now. `redwood-ctl ff ramp safetywave_toggle --to=50 --over=30s`

jamal: seeing a small uptick in reranker latency at 50% (+80ms p95). not yet at trigger but keeping eyes on it.

olivia: noted. what's the plan if reranker latency continues to drift? threshold to rollback or mitigate?

maria: mitigation order: 1) throttle reranker batch size, 2) enable fast-path quantized model on reranker, 3) rollback flag. if latency > +150ms sustained for 5m -> rollback.

kevin: pushing a fast-path quantized variant now to canary. `deploy-bot` will schedule a quick swap.

deploy-bot: fast-path model deploy started to infra-canary-3. ETA ~90s.

jamal: model swap done. reranker p95 back to +20ms. looks stable.

olivia: moving to 100% unless objections. we should keep a 30m soak at 100% before closing the change window.

maria: ok proceeding to 100%. tagging release notes: "safetywave: staged rollout, caching, reranker fast-path"

deploy-bot: safetywave_toggle ramped to 100%. System-wide telemetry shows no alerts. Soak period started (30m).

sre-oncall: monitoring. setting pager to high-sensitivity for 30m.

jamal: 12m into soak — seeing a small drift in regen latency on a specific shard (us-west-2-shard-4). low volume but consistent. filing quick repro.

olivia: nice catch. is it correlated to model shard or infra?

jamal: looks model-shard specific. maybe cache warming issue. I'll run the replay against shard-4.

deploy-bot: Alert: regen-latency spike on us-west-2-shard-4, p95 jumped +280ms for 3m.

maria: that's past the rollback lane for p95. Jamal, recommend immediate rollback for safetywave_toggle and drain canary.

jamal: +1 rollback. initiating: `redwood-ctl ff set safetywave_toggle false --force --note="auto-rollback: us-west-2-shard-4 p95"`

deploy-bot: safetywave_toggle set to false globally. Rolling back runtime changes on canary and draining cohorts.

kevin: unpinning fast-path model from global and pinning previous stable: `redwoodctl release pin rls-2026-03 --model model-v2.1.2`

olivia: I'll open a short postmortem doc and add the reproducer steps. tagging Eng-ML to triage model shard behavior.

maria: thank you everyone. nice clean rollback. we'll re-evaluate caching warmup and shard routing before reattempt. :white_check_mark:
